28 weeks = 28 × 7 = 196 days.  
Add 6 days → total 202 days.  
2001-09-06 + 202 days:  
September has 30 days, so from Sep 6 → Sep 30 is 24 days.  
202 − 24 = 178 days left.  
October 31 days, November 30 days, December 31 days → total 92 days (Oct–Dec).  
178 − 92 = 86 days into 2002.  
January 31 days, February 28 days (2002 not leap) → 59 days.  
86 − 59 = 27 days into March.  
Result: 2002-03-27.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 2002-03-27
